watch.summary: A streamer acknowledges chat's advice to take a break from Valorant, refuses to follow it, and immediately gets punished by matching onto a map he hates.

beats.what: Reads chat suggesting he take a break from Valorant.
Agrees taking a break makes sense, but hits start anyway.
A match is found instantly on the map Breeze.
He screams in anguish upon seeing it's Breeze.
Grips his head and cries that he should have listened.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I think taking a break actually does make sense, but we're not gonna do it though.
watch.why: The swift instant-karma of rejecting good advice only to get immediately loaded into a map he hates creates an instant comedic punishment. His dramatic over-the-top regret completes the classic hubris arc in under 12 seconds.
